To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
machine learning techniques are very useful in static analysis of malware.
the accuracy of static malware analysis is not as high as dynamic malware analysis.

the accuracy of machine learning aided static malware analysis can be improved by: (1) using more than one machine learning algorithm, (2) using different feature selection techniques and (3) using different data representation techniques.
In summary, our research is concerned with

three major objectives: (i) surveying the state of the art of ML-based static malware analysis techniques, (ii) developing taxonomy of these methods and (iii) offering a tutorial on how to apply ML in static malware analysis.

, there are many different machine learning techniques that can be used in static malware analysis and each one has its own pros and cons.
machine learning aided malware analysis is a very promising field that can be utilized in different aspects of cyber threat intelligence.
machine learning aided malware analysis is a powerful tool for static malware analysis and can provide a better understanding of different malware families and their behavior.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have provided a survey on the use of machine learning in the analysis of static characteristics of malware, we have also developed a taxonomy for better understanding, and we have provided a tutorial and an experimental evaluation of the methods.

we have developed a taxonomy for machine learning aided static malware analysis, and provided a tutorial for using different machine learning techniques to analyze static features of PE binaries and extract features that can be used for malware detection.
machine learning can be a powerful tool to automate the process of malware classification and analysis, however, it has its own challenges.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the accuracy of the machine learning techniques for classification of PE files is not as high as it is for other domains, but the accuracy is acceptable.
machine learning can be utilized to automate the process of extracting and analyzing static characteristics of PE files to detect malicious ones.
machine learning techniques can provide a practical and accurate solution for malware analysis and detection.
